uncited: **Forward Pass & Pixel Counting:** Render the scene from all input viewpoints.
For each Gaussian $G_i$ contributing to the image, determine the set of pixels $P_i$ it influences.
**Gradient Scaling:** Compute the standard positional gradient magnitude $||\nabla_{pos} G_i||$.
If $\tilde{g}_i > \tau$, mark $G_i$ for splitting or cloning.
**Splitting:** For marked Gaussians, create two new Gaussians by perturbing the position along the principal axes of the covariance matrix, halving the scale, and copying other attributes.
Reset $g_i$ and $c_i$ for the new primitives.
**Update:** Accumulate $\tilde{g}_i$ into the Gaussian's history for the next iteration.
